//Please leave any SCRIPTINFO lines generated by the Code Generation Wizards

//To Name
string ToName = data.LUPKEYVAL.APPNAME;

//To Email                                                                     (PKEYVAL = PKEYVAL)
string ToEmail = data.GetSQLValue("SELECT (CONTADD) FROM DCCONTACT c WHERE c.PKEYVAL='" + data.PKEYVAL.ToString() +  "' AND c.DCCONTTYPE = 'EMAIL' AND c.CONTADD LIKE('%@%')");


//Field Strings
string Ref = data.LUPKEYVAL.REFVAL;
string Proposal = data.LUPKEYVAL.PROPOSAL;
string SiteAddress = data.LUPKEYVAL.ADDRESS.Replace("\r"," ");
string Received = data.LUPKEYVAL.DATEAPRECV.ToString("d MMMM yyyy");
string Task = data.LUTASK_CODE.CODETEXT;
string TaskNotes = data.NOTES;



string emailbody = 
    "<p>Dear " + ToName + ",</p>" +

    "<p>Task Information: " + Task + "</p>" +

    "<p>Planning Application: <strong>" + Ref + "</strong><p>" +

    "<p>Site Address: <strong>" + SiteAddress + "</strong></p>" +

    "<p>Proposal: " + Proposal + "</p>" +

    "<p>We are continuing to manage your planning application. As per the above task information, please take note of the following which may require action on your part:</p>" +

    "<p><strong>Action Required:</strong> " + TaskNotes + "</p>" +

    "<p>Kind Regards</p>" +

    "<p>Edgehill Planning Department</p>" +

    "<p>Automated Workflow Notification Email</p>";




//EMAIL COMMAND - ***DO NOT TOUCH***

//This section relates to the SMTP setting in the Workflow set up - add the server details
System.Net.Mail.SmtpClient smtp = new 
                System.Net.Mail.SmtpClient(Plantech.Apps.Core.LibCore.RipOptions.Email.ucRipOptionPageEmailSmtp.SMTPServer);
System.Net.Mail.MailMessage mailMessage = new System.Net.Mail.MailMessage();    
mailMessage.Priority = System.Net.Mail.MailPriority.High;
smtp.Port = Plantech.Apps.Core.LibCore.RipOptions.Email.ucRipOptionPageEmailSmtp.SMTPPort;



//EMAIL HEADERS

mailMessage.To.Add(ToEmail);
//mailMessage.Bcc.Add("ian.woodland@idoxgroup.com");
//mailMessage.CC.Add("ian.woodland@idoxgroup.com");
mailMessage.Subject = "Application Information: " +  Task + " - " + Ref + " - " + SiteAddress;
mailMessage.From = new System.Net.Mail.MailAddress("ian.woodland@idoxgroup.com");
mailMessage.Body = emailbody;
mailMessage.IsBodyHtml = true;


//TASK DETAILS ARE USED TO IDENTIFY THE CASES AND TASKS IN THE AETASK TABLE FOR REPORTING PURPOSES

task.TaskTitle = "Task Information: " + Task;
task.TaskHint = Ref;
task.TaskHelp = SiteAddress;


//COMPLETION



int iEmail = data.GetSQLValueInt("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM AETASK s  WHERE s.TASKTABLEKEY='" + data.KEYVAL.ToString() + "' AND  s.TASKDEFID=3000");
{
if ((iEmail < 1)) 
               smtp.Send(mailMessage);
}

return false;
